hints.content: Each month, the total amount in the savings account grows by a constant **amount**, so it is best to use a linear function.
A linear function best models this relationship.

question.content:
Enrico deposited $\$2000$ in a savings account.  Each month he will deposit an additional $\$25$.

**Which kind of function best models the relationship between time and the total amount in the savings account?**

[[☃ radio 1]]
